subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1002
title: Allows a court to enter a supplemental eviction judgment within 180 days of an eviction judgment against a tenant who reenters the property, subject to the tenant's right to request a hearing.
headline: SB 1002 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1002 was introduced in the Senate on February 11, 2025.
SB 1002 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
